question: Which goddess is invoked to protect the speaker in the southern direction?
premises: Ḍākinī is named in the southern direction.
The glorious Mahābhairavī is also invoked.
Protection is sought for the speaker.
inference: Ḍākinī and the glorious Mahābhairavī are called to protect the speaker in the south.
uncertainties: syntactic distribution of the two names across the direction is compressed
plain_english: May Ḍākinī protect in the south, and may the glorious Mahābhairavī protect me.
